youtube.title: Which country has the most time zones? It's not the biggest one 🕰️
youtube.description:
Russia, the USA or the third one? The widest country on the map is not the widest on the clock: one nation's clocks sit 22 hours apart, and the country as wide as America chose a single time for everyone.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the table, the two islands at either end of the day, and the one-clock giant.
Which did you pick?
